question: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) launched the ‘JIVA’ programme’ in February 2022 to promote ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** natural farming**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **JIVA Programme by NABARD**:

 
 
• The **JIVA** programme, launched by the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)** in **February 2022**,
 
• It is aimed at promoting **natural farming**. T
 
• he initiative focuses on **sustainable and climate-resilient agricultural practices** to improve soil health, reduce dependency on chemical inputs, and boost farmers' incomes through natural methods of farming.
 
 
 
• **Goal of JIVA**:
 
 
• The programme is part of NABARD’s efforts to enhance agricultural productivity while promoting environmentally friendly practices and reducing farmers' reliance on costly synthetic fertilizers and pesticides.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Meaning of other options

 
• **Dairy Farming**: The breeding, raising, and management of dairy animals, primarily cows and buffaloes, for milk production.
 
• **Forest Gardening**: A sustainable land-use system that combines trees, shrubs, and plants in a layered structure to mimic natural forests, aimed at producing food and materials.
 
• **Horticulture**: The cultivation of fruits, vegetables, flowers, and ornamental plants for food, beauty, and medicinal purposes.
